heading: INT. HOLLOWAY VETERINARY CLINIC - WAITING ROOM - CONTINUOUS

units.text: INT. HOLLOWAY VETERINARY CLINIC - WAITING ROOM - CONTINUOUS
The camera whips around, a smear of light and floor and ceiling.
He is running now, the image jerking with each stride, his breathing a bellows, the chairs flashing past in rows.
Behind him claws skitter, closer, wet and hungry.
Go go go go go
units.name: NATE

units.text: He hits the front door and it doesn't open.
He hits it again.
He slams his shoulder into it and the glass shivers but holds, a deadbolt turned from the outside, a padlock hung on the other side by someone he never heard.
Through the glass he sees the lot, the van, and two TEENAGERS in matching letterman jackets standing at the edge of the pavement with their phones raised, filming him, one laughing, one not.
Hey! HEY! Open the door! Please! Open the door!
units.name: NATE

units.text: The laughing one waves.
The other lowers his phone slowly, and his face goes slack.
Behind Nate, the camera catches the reflection in the glass: the pale dog, in the center of the waiting room, standing on its hind legs.
Oh no.
units.name: NATE

units.text: ON PHONE: A final text drops, ignored, as the lens falls to the floor and tumbles.
"MO: im coming"
The picture rolls once, twice, and comes to rest at an angle, showing the ceiling tiles and one hand reaching, then a long dragging sound, then black.
TIMESTAMP: 12:09 AM.
The recording continues for nine more minutes with no picture.
Only sound.
FADE OUT.
